answer: The strongest single control I know for this is NFT holding duration proof, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 17 minutes once; the operator of 629 fakes spends 10693 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The vault sits in the mechanism itself, the jetty sits in the price of faking it, and the shale sits in the record no template can forge. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
